text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Thursday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:

- Prosecutor general Kazys Pednychia is expected to apply to parliament today to strip MP Audrius Butkevichius of his parliamentary immunity. Butkevichius was detained on Tuesday while allegedly taking a $15,000 bribe.

- The U.S. administration welcomed the move of Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius to initiate ammendments to the criminal code which would allow suspected war criminal Aleksandras Lileikis to be tried despite his poor health.
- The State Commercial Bank reported 7.7 million litas net profit for the first half of 1997.
- The assets of the Bank of Lithuania at the end of July stood at 4.95 billion litas.
- Lithunian railway posted a two million litas net profit for the first half of the year but still suffered losses from its passenger services.
- Estonian President Lenart Meri arrives for a state visit to Lithuania on August 20.
